name: ESP32-C6
notes: HP and LP CPUs both documented RV32IMAC; also confirmed in ESP32-C6 TRM v1.0 sections 1.1/1.2.

name: ESP32-C3
notes: Exact text from section 4.1.1.1: the lead sentence reads "ESP32-C3 has a lowpower 32-bit RISC-V singlecore microprocessor with the following features:" followed by the bullet "RV32IMC ISA". Document: ESP32-C3 Series Datasheet, Version 2.4. The documented string lists only I, M, and C, so Zba, Zbb, Zbs, and Zbc are absent.

name: ESP32-P4
notes: High-performance core, section 4.1.1.3, exact sentence: "The ESP32-P4 HP 32-bit RISC-V dualcore processor supports standard RV32IMAFCZc extensions, and it also contains a custom extended instruction set Xhwlp which reduces the number of instructions in the loop body to improve performance, and a custom AI and DSP extension Xai to improve operation efficiency of specific AI and DSP algorithms." The low-power core, section 4.1.1.4, documents "RV32IMAC ISA (instruction set architecture)". Document: ESP32-P4 Chip Revision v1.3 Datasheet, Version 1.2. Primary isaString is the HP core string RV32IMAFCZc. Both documented strings omit Zba, Zbb, Zbs, and Zbc. Xhwlp and Xai are custom nonstandard extensions and do not affect the absence determination for the standard extensions.

name: StarFive JH7110
notes: Exact text from section 2.1.2 U74 MC: "Fully compliant with the RISC-V ISA specification" and "4 x RV64GC U74 Application Cores". The same section documents a "1x RV64IMAC S7 Core" (note: S7 is only used for BOOTROM), and section 2.1.3 documents the "RV32IMFC E24 Core". Document: StarFive JH-7110 Datasheet, Version 1.63, per the Preface Table 0-1 Revision History (newest entry 2023/10/25). Hosted on doc-en.rvspace.org, StarFive's official English documentation portal; document pages carry "2018-2024 StarFive Technology" and www.starfivetech.com. All documented core strings omit Zba, Zbb, Zbs, and Zbc.

name: SiFive FU740
notes: Exact sentence from section 4.2 ISA: "The U74 RISC-V Core supports the RV64GC extension set." The same section notes the U74 also supports Zifencei and Zicsr. Document: SiFive FU740-C000 Manual, v1p8, May 14, 2026. The FU740 SoC also contains an S7 monitor core; the U74 is the application core relevant to this candidate. RV64GC as documented omits Zba, Zbb, Zbs, and Zbc.

name: SiFive FE310
notes: Exact sentence from section 1.2 E31 RISC-V Core: "The E31 core supports Machine and User privilege modes as well as standard Multiply, Atomic, and Compressed RISC-V extensions (RV32IMAC)." Section 3, Table 2 independently states "ISA RV32IMAC". Document: SiFive FE310-G002 Manual, v19p07, March 31, 2026 (internal document version; the URL filename references v1p7). RV32IMAC as documented omits Zba, Zbb, Zbs, and Zbc.

name: T-Head C906

source.section: Chapter 15 Appendix C Control registers, 15.1.2.2 Machine Mode Processor Instruction Set Architecture Register (MISA)

notes: Verified against the official open-source edition (XuanTie-OpenC906-UserManual, 2022-06-05, (c) 2022 T-Head, via T-Head's own Open Chip Community distribution). Chapter 4 documents "RV64GC (RV64IMAFDC)"; section 15.1.2.2 states: "C906 supports the RV64GC instruction set architecture, and the reset value of the MISA register is 64'h8000_0000_0094_112d." An earlier draft of this entry cited the commercial R1S0 Release 03 manual's RV64GCV string and MISA value 64'h8000_0000_00b4_112d; the document at the cited URL does not contain that text, so the entry now reports exactly what the cited source documents. RV64GC as documented omits Zba, Zbb, Zbs, and Zbc; multi-letter extensions would appear separately after an underscore.

name: T-Head C910

source.docTitle: XuanTie C910 and C920 R1S6 User Manual (xrvm)
source.section: 18.1.2.2 MISA (Machine Mode Processor Instruction Set Architecture Register)

notes: Exact sentence from section 18.1.2.2: "C910/C920 支持的指令集架构为 RV64GC，对应的 MISA 寄存器复位值为 0x800000000094112d。" (The instruction set architecture supported by C910/C920 is RV64GC; the MISA register reset value is 0x800000000094112d.) Document: 玄铁 C910 与 C920 R1S6 用户手册（xrvm）, Revision 06, dated 2025-01-24 (date from filename). Hosted on T-Head's own Open Chip Community OSS (occ-oss-prod). RV64GC as documented omits Zba, Zbb, Zbs, and Zbc.

notes: X60 core documents RVA22 with Zbb enumerated alongside Zba, Zbc, Zbs in the core feature list. Ships in Banana Pi BPI-F3, Milk-V Jupiter, SpacemiT MUSE.
